report_type: Native Decky UI implementation, regression audit and verified local deployment
changes: Native Field overview with ten monochrome SVG icons, native separators and Steam focus styling.
Native page Back receives focus once on entry; returning restores the selected overview module without stealing focus on polling or dropdown dismissal.
TDP profile summary shows selected limits from current editor/profile and actual power-source context; pending or failed profile reads never display unconfirmed draft limits.
Vibration has current settings first, all three stepped native sliders and native driver details disclosure after actions; technical endpoint data remains available.
Battery charging status precedes protection controls; both controller battery levels remain on overview and page.
Two static RGB ring previews use configured HSV and brightness; all actual RGB controls and full restore action remain available.

findings_fixed.issue: New TDP overview could display default or previous-game draft limits while a fresh profile read was pending.
findings_fixed.regression: Deferred game-profile reads and transitions assert a waiting state until fresh limits are confirmed.

findings_fixed.issue: Real QAM page entry left focus outside controls; explicit return could lose the selected module.
findings_fixed.regression: Ten-section navigation, module-withdrawal fallback, native refs, entry/back focus and no focus stealing during polling or visibility changes.
findings_fixed.device_proof: Native Enter opens all ten pages with Back focused; Back restores the original row; dropdown dismissal restores Insert combobox; one overview polling cycle retains Vibration focus.

findings_fixed.issue: Expanded Controller endpoints description is clipped horizontally when the actual sysfs path has a long segment.
findings_fixed.proposed_fix: Apply wrapping to the endpoint description text only; preserve the native Field and all endpoint data. Add a regression and confirm live width/screenshot after redeployment.
findings_fixed.scope_note: This continuation explicitly covered screenshots/report only, so no source or device-setting edits were performed.
findings_fixed.resolution: Endpoint-only block text with maxWidth 100% and overflowWrap anywhere; live description width/scrollWidth now268/268.
findings_fixed.regression_negative_control: Old presentation fails the wrapping contract; fixed presentation passes with two complete long real-like sysfs paths. Disclosure performs no hardware RPCs.

regression_validation.backend_run_scope: Backend sources and Python tests did not change after these runs. The later navigation focus adjustment was covered by all eleven frontend suites, typecheck, build and package checks.
